preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains a single integer t representing the number of test cases.
The total number of lines in stdin equals t + 1 (one header line and t test case lines).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s.strip()) <= 50 for s in t_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has a length between 1 and 50 inclusive.
Each test case string s consists only of Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == is_valid_substring(s) for line, s in zip(stdout_lines, t_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is 'YES' if and only if s is a substring of the infinite repetition of 'Yes', and 'NO' otherwise.
